liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (1 review, 1 other source): The space jam in this song is characterized as deep and weird; Only the first verse was performed, preceded by an extended instrumental prologue [3][14]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Reviewer highlights an exceptional performance of this song in the set [12]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 other source): Recording is cut at 1:15, missing most of the second verse [3]
- **Loose Lucy** (1 review): Reviewer specifically loves the performance of this song on the tape [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-07-01.127232.mtx.seamons.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 174 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd73-07-01.aud.lai.178.sbefail.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 164 min; rated 4.83/5 by 23 [2]. Said about its sound: Vocals sound slightly muffled, while instruments resemble a modern Neumann onstage mix; Vocals are low but audible; bass needs tweaking to hear Lesh clearly; Garcia's guitar comes across loud and crisp in the recording [9][11][13][20]
- **gd1973-07-01.fob.kaslow-todd.motb-0055.88528.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 162 min; rated 4.64/5 by 11 [3]
- **gd1973-07-01.fob.kaslow-todd.motb-0055.88608.flac24**: source not stated; 23 songs; 162 min; rated 3.5/5 by 8 [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended this concert as their first Grateful Dead show, having dosed beforehand [15]
- The Universal Amphitheatre did not yet have a roof at the time [22]
- Reviewer preferred this audience recording over the downloaded soundboard recording [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-07-01.127232.mtx.seamons.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix of SBD (shnid=127028): SBD -> Master Reel -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) and AUD (shnid=88528): Sony ECM-22P > Sony TC-770 > MAR > ?? [Dolby Encode]… [1]. Also: Original recording used Sony ECM-22P mics and Sony TC-770 recorder [1]
- **gd73-07-01.aud.lai.178.sbefail.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [2]. Also: Audience recording captured with Sony ECM-22P mics and Sony TC-770 recorder; Tape lineage includes Maxell UD 35-90 reel, DAT, and CDR [2]
- **gd1973-07-01.fob.kaslow-todd.motb-0055.88528.flac16**: taped by Harv Kaslow and Craig Todd; transferred by Rob Bertrando and A. Egert; source: Sony ECM-22P > Sony TC-770 > MAR > ?? [Dolby Encode] > R1 [3]
- **gd1973-07-01.fob.kaslow-todd.motb-0055.88608.flac24**: taped by Harv Kaslow and Craig Todd; transferred by Rob Bertrando, Barry Glassberg, A. Egert, J. Waddell; source: Sony ECM-22P > Sony TC-770 > MAR > ?? [Dolby Encode] > R1 [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Universal Amphitheatre - Promo](https://www.dead.net/archives/1973/clippings/universal-amphitheatre-promo) [24]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Universal Amphitheatre - July 1, 1973](https://www.dead.net/show/july-1-1973) [25]
